description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP242 edition 1's solid #1205: the edge at (-140.35, 69.85, 44.85), between the plane and the torus, filleted alone at the battery's radius 0.978. Open CASCADE builds it valid (volume 13011478.9, 160 faces). Arris chains through a kink at the edge's end (ADR-0075), and the walked blend's fit stays 6.6e-8 off at the 3363-span cap: `OpError::Internal` ("a geometry query failed: fit"), where before the chain was `TangentChain`. Eleven mirror and AP203 copies of the edge fail the same way (tolerant-tangency step 8's census); the second site, (-135.91, 70.81, 46.89), the same
